items.name: Advanced Weaponry
items.summary: Your eidolon's attack evolves.
items.description:
Your eidolon's attack evolves.

Choose one of your eidolon's starting melee unarmed attacks to gain one of the following traits, chosen when you gain the feat: disarm; grapple; nonlethal; shove; trip; or versatile B, P, or S.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Advanced Weaponry

items.name: Dual Studies
items.summary: You and your eidolon learn different skills.
items.description:
You and your eidolon learn different skills.

Choose two skills. Your eidolon becomes trained in one of those skills, and you become trained in the other skill.

At 7th level, you each become an expert in the chosen skills. Unlike other skill proficiencies, these proficiencies are not shared between you and your eidolon.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Dual Studies

items.name: Energy Heart
items.summary: Your eidolon's heart beats with energy.
items.description:
Your eidolon's heart beats with energy.

Choose acid, cold, electricity, or fire. One of their unarmed attacks changes its damage type to the chosen type, and they gain resistance to that type equal to half your level (minimum 1).
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Energy Heart

items.name: Expanded Senses
items.summary: Your eidolon evolves more acute senses.
items.description:
Your eidolon evolves more acute senses.

Your eidolon gains low-light vision and darkvision, as well as scent as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Expanded Senses

items.name: Extend Boost
items.summary: You can increase the duration of your eidolon's boosts.
items.description: You can increase the duration of your eidolon's boosts. You learn the Extend Boost link spell.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Extend Boost

items.name: Glider Form
items.summary: Your eidolon evolves wings, a buoyant body, or some other means to control descent.
items.description:
Your eidolon evolves wings, a buoyant body, or some other means to control descent.

They glide slowly toward the ground, 5 feet down and up to 25 feet forward through the air.

As long as they spend at least 1 action gliding each round and have not yet reached the ground, they remain in the air at the end of your turn.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Glider Form

items.name: Meld into Eidolon
items.summary: Your physical form can combine with that of your eidolon.
items.description:
Your physical form can combine with that of your eidolon.

You Manifest your Eidolon, but instead of summoning them into an adjacent open space, you become them. You can also Meld into Eidolon while your eidolon is manifested in an adjacent space. While Manifested in this way, you use your eidolon's statistics, and you can't act except to direct the eidolon to use Manifest an Eidolon to unmanifest themself. Your eidolon is affected by Boost Eidolon while Manifested in this way.

Since you can't act, you can't cast spells, activate or benefit from magic items that normally benefit you and not your eidolon, perform actions that have the tandem trait, or use other abilities that require you, and not the eidolon, to act.

You can't be separately targeted while you are melded into the eidolon. When you reach 0 HP, your eidolon unmanifests, leaving your body behind, unconscious and dying.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Meld into Eidolon

items.name: Unfetter Eidolon
items.summary: You can allow your eidolon to travel far from your side.
items.description: You can allow your eidolon to travel far from your side. You learn the Unfetter Eidolon link spell.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Unfetter Eidolon

items.name: Alacritous Action
items.summary: Your eidolon moves more quickly.
items.description: Your eidolon moves more quickly. Your eidolon's Speed increases by 10 feet.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Alacritous Action

items.name: Amphibious Form
items.summary: Your eidolon adapts to life on land and underwater.
items.description: Your eidolon adapts to life on land and underwater. They gain the amphibious trait, allowing them to breathe in water and air and to avoid the normal –2 penalty for making bludgeoning and slashing unarmed Strikes underwater. They gain a swim Speed equal to their land Speed or 25 feet, whichever is less; if they're normally aquatic, they gain a land Speed equal to their swim Speed or 25 feet, whichever is less.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Amphibious Form

items.name: Magical Understudy
items.summary: Your eidolon evolves to cast spells.
items.description: Your eidolon evolves to cast spells. They gain the Cast a Spell activity and learn two cantrips of their tradition, which they can cast as innate spells.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Magical Understudy

items.name: Ranged Combatant
items.summary: Spines, flame jets, and holy blasts are just some of the ways your eidolon might strike from a distance.
items.description:
Spines, flame jets, and holy blasts are just some of the ways your eidolon might strike from a distance. Your eidolon gains a ranged unarmed attack with a range increment of 30 feet that deals 1d4 damage and has the magical and propulsive traits.

When you select this feat, choose a damage type for the attack: acid, bludgeoning, cold, electricity, fire, piercing, slashing, spirit, vitality, or void.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Ranged Combatant

items.name: Reinforce Eidolon
items.summary: You buffer your eidolon.
items.description: You buffer your eidolon. You gain the Reinforce Eidolon link cantrip.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Reinforce Eidolon

items.name: Steed Form
items.summary: Your eidolon changes to make them particularly effective as your mount.
items.description: Your eidolon changes to make them particularly effective as your mount. While you ride them, you get your full number of actions each round instead of reducing them to 2. This applies only when you ride your eidolon, not when anyone else does. Your eidolon still must be at least one size category larger than you to ride them. Since you work together to move, your eidolon's move actions while you're mounted gain the tandem trait.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Steed Form

items.name: Bloodletting Claws
items.summary: Your eidolon inflicts bleeding wounds on a telling blow.
items.description: Your eidolon inflicts bleeding wounds on a telling blow. If your eidolon critically hits with a melee unarmed Strike that deals slashing or piercing damage, their target takes 1d6 persistent bleed damage. Your eidolon gains an item bonus to this bleed damage equal to the unarmed attack's item bonus to attack rolls. This is a critical specialization effect.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Bloodletting Claws

items.name: Defend Summoner
items.summary: Your eidolon blocks attacks against you.
items.description: Your eidolon blocks attacks against you. After your eidolon uses this action, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC until the beginning of your next turn. This bonus applies only while you're within your eidolon's reach (in most cases, this means your eidolon is adjacent to you or in your space).
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Defend Summoner

items.name: Dual Energy Heart
items.summary: A second energy dwells in your eidolon.
items.description: A second energy dwells in your eidolon. Choose an additional damage type from the list in Energy Heart. Your eidolon's unarmed attack that deals energy damage gains the versatile trait for the second energy damage type, and your eidolon gains resistance to the second type of energy damage equal to half your level.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Dual Energy Heart

items.name: Lifelink Surge
items.summary: You can tap into your shared connection to heal your eidolon.
items.description: You can tap into your shared connection to heal your eidolon. You gain the Lifelink Surge link spell.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Lifelink Surge

items.name: Reactive Dismissal
items.summary: You abruptly dismiss your eidolon to reduce the damage they take, though this makes summoning them again more difficult.
items.description:
**Trigger** Your eidolon would take damage.

You abruptly dismiss your eidolon to reduce the damage they take, though this makes summoning them again more difficult. Reduce the triggering damage to your eidolon by double your level, and your eidolon unmanifests. You can't Manifest your Eidolon again until after the end of your next turn.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Reactive Dismissal

items.name: Shrink Down
items.summary: Your eidolon can shrink to fit into small spaces.
items.description: Your eidolon can shrink to fit into small spaces. Your eidolon reduces to a smaller size of your choosing, to a minimum of size Small. They can Dismiss this action to return to their normal size. Their reach becomes 5 feet, or 10 feet if shrinking to Large with Towering Size.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Shrink Down

items.name: Skilled Partner
items.summary: Your eidolon gains a 1st-level skill feat and a 2nd-level or lower skill feat.
items.description: Your eidolon gains a 1st-level skill feat and a 2nd-level or lower skill feat. At 7th level, your eidolon gains an additional skill feat of 7th level or lower.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Skilled Partner

items.name: Tandem Movement
items.summary: You and your eidolon move together.
items.description: You and your eidolon move together. You each use a single action to Stride. Either of you that has the corresponding movement type can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Tandem Movement

items.name: Vibration Sense
items.summary: Your eidolon gains Tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.
items.description: Your eidolon gains Tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet. If aquatic, it gains Wavesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet instead. If amphibious, it gains both.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Vibration Sense

items.name: Blood Frenzy
items.summary: Your eidolon flies into a frenzy.
items.description:
**Requirements** Your eidolon's last action dealt bleed damage to a living creature.

Your eidolon flies into a frenzy. While in the frenzy, your eidolon is affected by Boost Eidolon and gains temporary HP equal to your level, but takes a –1 penalty to AC. The temporary HP last until the frenzy ends. They can't voluntarily end the frenzy or start another frenzy while in the frenzy.

The frenzy lasts for 1 minute or until your eidolon is no longer manifested, whichever comes first, after which your eidolon can't start another frenzy for 1 minute.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Blood Frenzy

items.name: Eidolon's Retort
items.summary: Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature.
items.description:
**Trigger** A creature within your eidolon's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, your eidolon disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward your multiple attack penalty, and your multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Eidolon's Retort

items.name: Eidolon's Wrath
items.summary: Your eidolon gains the Eidolon's Wrath link spell, which they cast, instead of you.
items.description: Your eidolon gains the Eidolon's Wrath link spell, which they cast, instead of you. You determine the damage type when you gain the feat: acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, spirit, vitality, or void. As normal, your eidolon shares your Focus Points.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Eidolon's Wrath

items.name: Master Summoner
items.summary: During daily preparations, you can designate one of your spell slots to become two summoning slots of the same spell rank, from which you can cast only spells with the summon or incarnate trait.
items.description: During daily preparations, you can designate one of your spell slots to become two summoning slots of the same spell rank, from which you can cast only spells with the summon or incarnate trait.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Master Summoner

items.name: Ostentatious Arrival
items.summary: If the next action you take is to Manifest your Eidolon as a three-action activity, or to Cast a 3-action summon or incarnate Spell, the creature appears in an explosion.
items.description:
If the next action you take is to Manifest your Eidolon as a three-action activity, or to Cast a 3-action summon or incarnate Spell, the creature appears in an explosion.

All creatures in a 10-foot emanation around the creature you summoned or manifested except you take 1d4 fire damage per spell rank for a summon or incarnate spell, or 1d4 damage per 2 levels for Manifesting your Eidolon.

If the creature you summoned or manifested has the acid, cold, electricity, fire, sonic, or water trait, the damage is that type instead (or bludgeoning damage for the water trait). If the creature has more than one of these traits, you choose which damage type to deal.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Ostentatious Arrival

items.name: Phase Out
items.summary: Your eidolon phases out of reality slightly, gaining resistance to all damage (except force, spirit, and vitality) equal to half your level.
items.description:
Your eidolon phases out of reality slightly, gaining resistance to all damage (except force, spirit, and vitality) equal to half your level. They're not incorporeal, but can't use Strikes or actions that require a fully physical form, such as Grapple, Reposition, Shove, or Trip.

Your eidolon can Dismiss this effect to return to their normal form.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Phase Out

items.name: Tandem Strike
items.summary: You and your eidolon each attack, seamlessly targeting the same foe without interfering with each other's movements.
items.description:
**Requirements** A creature is in reach of both you and your eidolon.

You and your eidolon each attack, seamlessly targeting the same foe without interfering with each other's movements. Your eidolon makes a melee Strike, and then you make a melee Strike against the same creature. If both Strikes hit, combine their damage for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. Both attacks count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks have been made.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Tandem Strike

items.name: Boost Summons
items.summary: Augmenting your eidolon extends to creatures you summon.
items.description: Augmenting your eidolon extends to creatures you summon. When you cast Boost Eidolon, in addition to your eidolon, it also targets your summoned creatures within 60 feet.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Boost Summons

items.name: Constricting Hold
items.summary: Your eidolon constricts the creature, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to your eidolon's level plus their Strength modifier, with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC.
items.description:
**Requirements** Your eidolon has a creature grabbed or restrained.

Your eidolon constricts the creature, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to your eidolon's level plus their Strength modifier, with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Constricting Hold

items.name: Energy Resistance
items.summary: Your eidolon has stronger resistance.
items.description: Your eidolon has stronger resistance. Their resistance from Energy Heart and Dual Energy Heart increases to your level.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Energy Resistance

items.name: Hulking Size
items.summary: Your eidolon grows substantially.
items.description: Your eidolon grows substantially. Your eidolon becomes Large, instead of their previous size, and their reach increases to 10 feet. This doesn't change any of their other statistics.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Hulking Size

items.name: Magical Adept
items.summary: Your eidolon gains more magic.
items.description: Your eidolon gains more magic. Choose one 2nd-rank spell and one 1st-rank spell of your eidolon's tradition. Your eidolon can cast them each once per day as innate spells. At every even level after you take this feat, your eidolon can swap one of these innate spells for a new innate spell that's 2 or more ranks lower than your highest-rank spell slot.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Magical Adept

items.name: Miniaturize
items.summary: Your eidolon can shrink even further.
items.description: Your eidolon can shrink even further. When using Shrink Down, your eidolon can reduce their size to Tiny. When Tiny, their reach is 0 feet.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Miniaturize

items.name: Surprising Leap
items.summary: Your eidolon jumps into the air to attack a foe.
items.description:
Your eidolon jumps into the air to attack a foe. Your eidolon makes a Leap, High Jump, or Long Jump and attempts one melee Strike at any point during that jump. Immediately after the Strike, your eidolon falls to the ground if they're in the air, even if they haven't reached the maximum distance of their jump. If the distance your eidolon falls is no more than the height of their jump, your eidolon takes no damage and lands upright.

When attempting a High Jump or Long Jump during a Surprising Leap, determine the jump distance using Long Jump's rules, and change your eidolon's maximum distance to double their Speed.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Surprising Leap

items.name: Burrowing Form
items.summary: Your eidolon can burrow through loose dirt.
items.description: Your eidolon can burrow through loose dirt. Your eidolon gains a burrow Speed of 15 feet.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Burrowing Form

items.name: Magical Onslaught
items.summary: Your eidolon's attack provides you an opening for one of your spells.
items.description: Your eidolon's attack provides you an opening for one of your spells. Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against a creature, and then you cast a 1- or 2-action cantrip targeting the same creature. If your eidolon's Strike hits, the creature is off-guard against your spell (if it requires a spell attack roll) or takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its save against your spell (if it requires a saving throw). If your eidolon's Strike and the spell deal the same type of damage, combine the damage of both for the purpose of resistances and weaknesses. Both your eidolon's attack and any spell attack roll you make count toward your multiple attack penalty, but the penalty doesn't increase until after both attacks have been made.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Magical Onslaught

items.name: Merciless Rend
items.summary: Your eidolon rends their foes.
items.description:
**Requirements** Your eidolon hit the same enemy with two consecutive unarmed Strikes this turn and dealt slashing damage with both.

Your eidolon rends their foes. They automatically deal the damage from their secondary attack to the enemy.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Merciless Rend

items.name: Nimble Form
items.summary: Your eidolon evolves into a figure of pure grace.
items.description: Your eidolon evolves into a figure of pure grace. Your multiple attack penalty from your eidolon's agile unarmed attacks becomes –3 for a second attack and –6 for subsequent attacks (rather than –4 and –8).
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Nimble Form

items.name: Protective Bond
items.summary: The power of your bond can protect you and your eidolon from harm.
items.description:
**Trigger** You and your eidolon are in a damaging effect's area.

The power of your bond can protect you and your eidolon from harm. If you and your eidolon would take different amounts of damage from the area effect, you take the lower amount of damage instead of the greater amount of damage.

**Special** This feat has the trait matching your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Protective Bond

items.name: Transpose
items.summary: You switch places with your eidolon.
items.description:
You switch places with your eidolon. You each teleport to the other's position.

**Special** This feat has the trait matching your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Transpose

items.name: Weighty Impact
items.prerequisites: Your eidolon has an unarmed attack with the shove or trip trait
items.summary: Your eidolon hurls enemies to the ground or across the battlefield.
items.description: Your eidolon hurls enemies to the ground or across the battlefield. Choose one of the eidolon's unarmed attacks that has the shove or trip trait. The attack gains the other trait as well, and your eidolon gains the Knockdown and Push actions for that attack.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Weighty Impact

items.name: Airborne Form
items.summary: Your eidolon can fly.
items.description: Your eidolon can fly. It gains a fly Speed equal to its Speed.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Airborne Form

items.name: Flexible Transmogrification
items.summary: You've learned how to transmogrify your eidolon to suit the circumstances of the day.
items.description: You've learned how to transmogrify your eidolon to suit the circumstances of the day. Each day, choose one evolution feat of 6th level or lower during your daily preparations. Your eidolon gains that feat until your next daily preparations.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Flexible Transmogrification

items.name: Grasping Limbs
items.summary: Your eidolon grabs enemies.
items.description: Your eidolon grabs enemies. Choose one of the eidolon's unarmed attacks with the grapple trait. Your eidolon gains the Grab action on that unarmed attack.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Grasping Limbs

items.name: Link Focus
items.summary: Communing with your eidolon helps you achieve a deeper focus.
items.description: Communing with your eidolon helps you achieve a deeper focus. Whenever you Refocus, you completely refill your focus pool.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Link Focus

items.name: Summoner's Call
items.summary: In a moment of danger, you call your eidolon to your side.
items.description:
**Trigger** You or your eidolon take damage from a foe or hazard.

**Requirements** Your eidolon is manifested and is more than 5 feet away from you.

In a moment of danger, you call your eidolon to your side. Your eidolon teleports to an open space adjacent to you.

**Special** This feat has the trait matching your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Summoner's Call

items.name: Towering Size
items.summary: Your eidolon becomes even bigger.
items.description: Your eidolon becomes even bigger. They become Huge, instead of Large, and the reach on all of their attacks increases to 15 feet.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Towering Size

items.name: Guiding Retort
items.summary: With a cunning twist of their unarmed attack, your eidolon shifts the position of a foe.
items.description: With a cunning twist of their unarmed attack, your eidolon shifts the position of a foe. When your eidolon uses Eidolon's Retort to Strike and hits, your eidolon can Reposition the target up to 10 feet.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Guiding Retort

items.name: Piercing Jab
items.summary: Your eidolon runs an enemy through with a horn or similar attack.
items.description:
**Requirements** Your eidolon's primary attack deals piercing damage.

Your eidolon runs an enemy through with a horn or similar attack. Your eidolon makes a melee Strike with their primary attack. If the Strike hits and deals damage, the target is grabbed by your eidolon until it successfully Escapes, your eidolon attacks with their primary attack again, or your eidolon is no longer manifested, whichever comes first. When the target is no longer grabbed, it takes persistent bleed damage equal to the primary attack's number of weapon damage dice.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Piercing Jab

items.name: Resilient Shell
items.summary: Your eidolon is resilient against attacks.
items.description: Your eidolon is resilient against attacks. They gain resistance 5 to physical damage. At 17th level, the resistance increases to 6.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Resilient Shell

items.name: Share Eidolon Magic
items.summary: Your eidolon shares innate spells with you.
items.description: Your eidolon shares innate spells with you. You can cast the innate spells your eidolon gained from Magical Understudy, Magical Adept, and Magical Master. You and your eidolon share the same daily uses of these innate spells.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Share Eidolon Magic

items.name: Spell-Repelling Form
items.summary: Your eidolon evolves to protect itself from the danger of spells.
items.description: Your eidolon evolves to protect itself from the danger of spells. They gain a +1 status bonus to all saving throws against magic.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Spell-Repelling Form

items.name: Eidolon's Trample
items.summary: Your eidolon Strides up to double their Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space they enter.
items.description:
Your eidolon Strides up to double their Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space they enter. They can attempt to Trample the same creature only once in a single Trample.

Your eidolon deals bludgeoning damage equal to the damage of their secondary attack against these creatures, with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Eidolon's Trample

items.name: Ever-Vigilant Senses
items.summary: Your eidolon has enhanced senses.
items.description:
Your eidolon has enhanced senses. They gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception and can't be flanked except by creatures that are higher level than them.

They can see invisible creatures and objects, which appear translucent and are concealed.

When your eidolon moves within 30 feet of an illusion that can be disbelieved, the GM rolls a secret check to disbelieve it, even if your eidolon didn't spend an action to Interact.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Ever-Vigilant Senses

items.name: Hobbling Criticals
items.summary: Your eidolon's unarmed attacks batter your foes into submission, hampering their movement.
items.description:
Your eidolon's unarmed attacks batter your foes into submission, hampering their movement. Whenever your eidolon gets a critical hit with one of their unarmed Strikes, the target must attempt a Fortitude save against your spell DC after taking the damage. This is a critical specialization effect.

**Critical Success** The target takes no additional effect.

**Success** The target takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

**Failure** The target is Slowed 1 and takes a –10-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.

**Critical Failure** The target is Slowed 2 and takes a –15-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds for 1 round.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Hobbling Criticals

items.name: Magical Master
items.summary: Your eidolon gains a bevy of lower-rank spells.
items.description:
Your eidolon gains a bevy of lower-rank spells. Choose an innate spell of your eidolon's tradition of each of the spell ranks from 1 to 7 in which your eidolon doesn't currently have an innate spell from Magical Adept. Your eidolon can cast each once per day as innate spells.

You can swap these spells at every even level, but your eidolon can never know more than one spell of each spell rank 1 through 7.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Magical Master

items.name: True Transmogrification
items.summary: You transmogrify your eidolon each day.
items.description: You transmogrify your eidolon each day. During your daily preparations, you can swap out any number of your evolution feats, each for a different evolution feat of an appropriate level for which you meet the prerequisites. These swaps last until your next daily preparations.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: True Transmogrification

items.name: Eternal Boost
items.summary: Your link with your eidolon is so intense that you continuously reinforce their abilities.
items.description:
Your link with your eidolon is so intense that you continuously reinforce their abilities. You are permanently quickened; you can use your extra action only to cast Boost Eidolon or Reinforce Eidolon.

While in exploration mode, you can declare that you are also continually casting *boost eidolon* or *reinforce eidolon* even while using a different exploration activity. If you do, even before your first turn in a combat encounter, that cantrip is active as if you had cast it on your previous turn.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Eternal Boost

items.name: Legendary Summoner
items.summary: Your ability to summon extends past your other spellcasting.
items.description:
Your ability to summon extends past your other spellcasting. When you sacrifice a 9th-rank spell slot to gain two summoning slots using Master Summoner, you can use those slots to cast summon or incarnate spells heightened to 10th rank.

You can't use these spell slots for any purpose other than casting the summon or incarnate spells, and you don't count as having 10th-rank spell slots for other abilities or rules.
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Legendary Summoner

items.name: Twin Eidolon
items.summary: You can transform to match your eidolon.
items.description:
You can transform to match your eidolon. When you Manifest your Eidolon, you can call upon their powers to transform yourself into a duplicate until your eidolon unmanifests. You can't use this if you Manifest your Eidolon in an unusual way, such as Meld into Eidolon.

While using Twin Eidolon, you use your eidolon's statistics other than your own Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma attribute modifiers, including their evolutions. You can't cast spells (except spells your eidolon could cast), Activate or otherwise benefit from magic items that normally benefit you and not your eidolon, or use other actions they can't perform.

Any of their spells you cast with limited uses count against your eidolon's uses. You can Manifest your Eidolon again to end this effect.

**Special** This feat has the trait matching your eidolon's tradition (arcane, divine, occult, or primal).
items.cite: Impossible Magic — Feats: Twin Eidolon

items.name: Ammunition Thaumaturgy
items.summary: You're so used to handling your implement, weapon, and esoterica in the heat of combat that adding a few bullets or arrows to the mix is no extra burden.
items.description: You're so used to handling your implement, weapon, and esoterica in the heat of combat that adding a few bullets or arrows to the mix is no extra burden. You can Interact to reload a weapon using the hand holding your implement.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Ammunition Thaumaturgy

items.name: Diverse Lore
items.summary: Your wandering studies mean you've heard rumors or theories about almost every topic...
items.description: Your wandering studies mean you've heard rumors or theories about almost every topic... though admittedly, your sources aren't always the most reliable. You can take a -2 penalty to your check to Recall Knowledge with Esoteric Lore to Recall Knowledge about any topic, not just the usual topics available for Esoteric Lore. Additionally, when you succeed at your check to Exploit a Vulnerability, compare the result of your Esoteric Lore check to the DC to Recall Knowledge for that creature; if that number would be a success or a critical success, you gain information as if you had succeeded at the Recall Knowledge check.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Diverse Lore

items.name: Divine Disharmony
items.summary: From your collection of religious trinkets, you pull out opposing divine objects-such as the religious symbols of two deities that are hated enemies-and combine them in a display that causes…
items.description:
From your collection of religious trinkets, you pull out opposing divine objects-such as the religious symbols of two deities that are hated enemies-and combine them in a display that causes discordant clashes of divine energy that are especially distracting to the faithful. Roll your choice of a Deception or Intimidation check against the Will DC of a creature you can see within 60 feet, with the following results. If the creature is particularly devoted to a deity, such as a cleric, celestial, monitor, fiend, or other creature with divine spells, you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your skill check. The GM might determine that a creature that despises all deities, such as an alghollthu, is unaffected.

**Critical Success** The creature is off-guard to your attacks until the end of your next turn.

**Success** The creature is off-guard to your attacks until the end of your current turn.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Divine Disharmony

items.name: Haunt Ingenuity
items.summary: Your cunning knowledge grants you the ability to notice the emotional echo of a soul that passed on, leaving a haunt in its wake.
items.description:
Your cunning knowledge grants you the ability to notice the emotional echo of a soul that passed on, leaving a haunt in its wake. Even when you aren't Searching while in exploration mode, the GM rolls a secret check for you to notice haunts that usually require you to be Searching.

You can disable haunts that require master proficiency in a skill as long as you're at least trained in the skill. If you have master proficiency in the skill, you can disable haunts that require a proficiency rank of legendary instead.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Haunt Ingenuity

items.name: Root to Life
items.summary: ◆ or ◆◆
items.description:
◆ or ◆◆

Marigold, spider lily, pennyroyal-many primal traditions connect flowers and plants with the boundary between life and death, and you can leverage this association to keep an ally on this side of the line. You place a small plant or similar symbol on an adjacent dying creature, immediately stabilizing them; the creature is no longer dying and is instead unconscious at 0 Hit Points.

If you spend 2 actions instead of 1, you empower the act further by uttering a quick folk blessing to chase away ongoing pain, adding the auditory trait to the action. When you do so, attempt flat checks to remove each source of persistent damage affecting the target; due to the particularly effective assistance, the DC is 10 instead of the usual 15.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Root to Life

items.name: Scroll Thaumaturgy
items.summary: Your multidisciplinary study of magic means you know how to activate the magic in scrolls with ease.
items.description: Your multidisciplinary study of magic means you know how to activate the magic in scrolls with ease. You can activate scrolls of any magical tradition, using your thaumaturge class DC for the scroll's DC, rather than a particular spell DC. If a spell is on the spell list for multiple traditions, you choose which tradition to use at the time you activate the scroll. You can draw and activate scrolls with the same hand holding an implement, much like you can for esoterica.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Scroll Thaumaturgy

items.name: Call Implement
items.summary: You can tug on the bonds of ownership between yourself and your implement, causing it to find its way back to you.
items.description:
**Requirements** You have a free hand.

You can tug on the bonds of ownership between yourself and your implement, causing it to find its way back to you. You look down and find that your implement has mysteriously appeared in your free hand, as long as the implement was within 1 mile and on the same plane of existence. If your implement is attended by another creature, that creature can prevent the implement from teleporting away if it succeeds at a Will save against your class DC. If the creature succeeds, you can't attempt to Call that Implement again until midnight.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Call Implement

items.name: Esoteric Warden
items.summary: When you apply antithetical material against a creature successfully, you also ward yourself against its next attacks.
items.description: When you apply antithetical material against a creature successfully, you also ward yourself against its next attacks. When you succeed at your check to Exploit a Vulnerability, you gain a +1 status bonus to your AC against the creature's next attack and a +1 status bonus to your next saving throw against the creature; if you critically succeed, these bonuses are +2 instead. You can gain these bonuses only once per day against a particular creature, and the benefit ends if you Exploit Vulnerability again.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Esoteric Warden

items.name: Talisman Esoterica
items.summary: You know how to assemble the supernatural objects in your esoterica into a number of temporary talismans.
items.description:
You know how to assemble the supernatural objects in your esoterica into a number of temporary talismans. Each day during your daily preparations, you can make two talismans with an item level no higher than half your level. You must know each talisman's formula. A talisman created this way is a temporary item and loses its magic the next time you make your daily preparations.

You know the formulas for all common talismans in GM Core of your level or lower. You remember your talisman formulas through oral tradition or mnemonics, so you don't need a formula book for them.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Talisman Esoterica

items.name: Turn Away Misfortune
items.summary: You perform a superstition, such as casting salt over your shoulder to ward off bad luck.
items.description:
**Trigger** You would attempt a roll affected by a misfortune effect.

You perform a superstition, such as casting salt over your shoulder to ward off bad luck. Turn Away Misfortune's fortune trait cancels out the misfortune effect, causing you to roll normally. As normal, you can apply only one fortune ability to a roll, so if you Turned Away Misfortune on an attack roll, you couldn't also use an ability like Halfling Luck to alter the roll further.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Turn Away Misfortune

items.name: Breached Defenses
items.summary: You can find the one weak point in a creature's scales, wards, roll further.
items.description:
You can find the one weak point in a creature's scales, wards, roll further. or armor to get past its resistances. When you succeed at Exploit Vulnerability, you learn about the highest of the creature's resistances that can be bypassed (for example, if the creature has resistance to physical damage except silver), if the creature has one. If you prefer, you can choose the following benefit instead of one of the usual two benefits from Exploit Vulnerability.

**Breached Defenses** You can choose this benefit only if you succeeded at Exploit Vulnerability and learned the creature has at least one resistance that can be bypassed. Choose one such resistance. Your unarmed and weapon Strikes bypass the chosen resistance.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Breached Defenses

items.name: Paired Link
items.summary: You break a trinket, such as a lodestone or jade pendant, in two, creating a sympathetic link between the halves that bridges distance.
items.description: You break a trinket, such as a lodestone or jade pendant, in two, creating a sympathetic link between the halves that bridges distance. During your daily preparations, you perform a short ceremony where you gift one of the two halves to a willing ally. On that ally, you can cast spells and use thaumaturge abilities targeting your paired ally as though you are adjacent to each other, and the ally can cast spells targeting you in the same way. These effects last as long as you and the ally have their half; if either half leaves either of your possessions for even a moment, or if you establish a link with a new ally during your next daily preparations, the link breaks.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Paired Link

items.name: One More Activation
items.summary: You've forged a deeper bond to your invested items, allowing you to activate them more than usual.
items.description: You've forged a deeper bond to your invested items, allowing you to activate them more than usual. Once each day, you can Activate an Item you've invested even after you've used that activation the maximum number of times for its frequency. You can do so only if the item's level is half your level or lower, the activation has a frequency of once per day or more frequent, and you haven't already used the activation this round.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: One More Activation

items.name: Scroll Esoterica
items.summary: Your esoterica includes scraps of scriptures, magic tomes, druidic markings, and the like, which you can use to create temporary scrolls.
items.description:
Your esoterica includes scraps of scriptures, magic tomes, druidic markings, and the like, which you can use to create temporary scrolls. Each day during your daily preparations, you can create a single temporary scroll containing a 1st-rank spell of any tradition. The spell must be common, or you must otherwise have access to it. This scroll is an unstable, temporary item and loses its magic the next time you make your daily preparations if you haven't used it by then. It can't be used to Learn the Spell.

At 8th level, add a second temporary scroll containing a 2nd-rank spell.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Scroll Esoterica

items.name: Sympathetic Vulnerabilities
items.prerequisites: Exploit Vulnerability; mortal weakness or personal antithesis
items.summary: When you apply your will to invoke a vulnerability, the result is more powerful, and the vulnerability ripples out in a web from your main target to affect a broader range of creatures.
items.description:
When you apply your will to invoke a vulnerability, the result is more powerful, and the vulnerability ripples out in a web from your main target to affect a broader range of creatures. This has one of two effects, based on the type of vulnerability you invoked.

While you have mortal weakness applied, your Strikes also apply that weakness against any creature that has that weakness, not just creatures of the exact same kind. For instance, if you used mortal weakness against a cinder dragon to apply its weakness to cold to your Strikes, those Strikes would also apply to the weakness to cold of fire elementals or any other creature with a weakness to cold.

While you have personal antithesis applied to a non-humanoid creature, you can apply your custom weakness to all creatures of the exact same kind. For example, if you used personal antithesis against an ort, the custom weakness would apply to other orts but not to other types of devils.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Sympathetic Vulnerabilities

items.name: Cursed Effigy
items.summary: After your attack, you grab a bit of blood, cut hair, or other piece of the creature's body.
items.description:
**Requirements** Your last action was a successful Strike against the target of your Exploit Vulnerability, and the Strike dealt physical damage.

After your attack, you grab a bit of blood, cut hair, or other piece of the creature's body. You incorporate the material into a premade doll, paper figure, or other effigy to create a sympathetic link that makes it harder to resist your abilities. As long as you are Exploiting Vulnerability against that creature, it takes a –2 status penalty to its saving throws against thaumaturge abilities or items that use your thaumaturge class DC.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Cursed Effigy

items.name: Elaborate Talisman Esoterica
items.summary: As you continue to collect talismanic esoterica, you improve your ability to create temporary talismans.
items.description:
As you continue to collect talismanic esoterica, you improve your ability to create temporary talismans. You can create four temporary talismans each day instead of two.

**Special** You can select this feat a second time if you are 14th level or higher, allowing you to create six talismans each day instead of four.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Elaborate Talisman Esoterica

items.name: Know-It-All
items.summary: Bard When you succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge, you gain additional information or context.
items.description:
**Bard** When you succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge, you gain additional information or context. When you critically succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge, you get additional information or context or can ask an additional follow-up question (the GM chooses which).

**Thaumaturge** Having heard and scrutinized every rumor or story in the book, you know for a fact that if you've heard something at all, you've probably heard about it at great length. When you succeed or critically succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge, you can ask an additional follow-up question. At the GM's discretion, you might gain even more additional context than normal.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Know-It-All

items.name: Share Weakness
items.summary: You select an object from your esoterica that has great personal value to you, such as a locket or treasured ring, and you grant it to an adjacent ally, establishing a personal link that allows your…
items.description:
**Requirements** You are Exploiting a creature's Vulnerability using mortal weakness.

You select an object from your esoterica that has great personal value to you, such as a locket or treasured ring, and you grant it to an adjacent ally, establishing a personal link that allows your ally to affect an enemy as if they were you. The ally's Strikes apply the weakness from your mortal weakness the same way your Strikes do. This benefit ends when your Exploit Vulnerability ends or you Share Weakness again.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Share Weakness

items.name: Thaumaturge's Investiture
items.summary: Magical equipment and gear are the tools of your trade, and you know you need as many as possible to help you against the supernatural.
items.description: Magical equipment and gear are the tools of your trade, and you know you need as many as possible to help you against the supernatural. Thus, mastering the efficient use of such magical equipment is a matter of great importance. You gain the Incredible Investiture skill feat, increasing your limit on invested items from 10 to 12. The limit increases to 14 if you have Charisma +4, 16 if you have Charisma +5, 18 if you have Charisma +6, and 20 if you have Charisma +7.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Thaumaturge's Investiture

items.name: Twin Weakness
items.summary: As you make an attack augmented by your esoterica, you also press your implement against the creature, applying its weakness as your implement's energies sear the creature's flesh.
items.description:
**Requirements** You're holding an implement and a weapon, you are using Exploit Vulnerability with mortal weakness or personal antithesis, and the target creature is within reach of both your implement and weapon.

As you make an attack augmented by your esoterica, you also press your implement against the creature, applying its weakness as your implement's energies sear the creature's flesh. Make a melee Strike against the target of your Exploit Vulnerability. On any attack roll result but a critical failure, you also press your implement against the creature, automatically dealing the additional damage from Exploit Vulnerability. This is in addition to any damage from your Strike, including the weakness the Strike applies from Exploit Vulnerability. This counts as two attacks when calculating your multiple attack penalty.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Twin Weakness

items.name: Elaborate Scroll Esoterica
items.summary: You've picked up more scraps of magic texts, improving your makeshift scrolls.
items.description: You've picked up more scraps of magic texts, improving your makeshift scrolls. In addition to your daily scrolls from Scroll Esoterica, add a scroll with a 3rd-rank spell. At 14th level, add a scroll with a 4th-rank spell. At 16th level, add a scroll with a 5th-rank spell.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Elaborate Scroll Esoterica

items.name: Intensify Investiture
items.summary: Your bond to your invested items enables you to put more of yourself into them.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per 10 minutes

Your bond to your invested items enables you to put more of yourself into them. If you next action is to activate an invested item that has a saving throw DC, you can use your thaumaturge class DC instead of the item's DC if it is higher.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Intensify Investiture

items.name: Shared Warding
items.summary: You ward your allies from the attacks of your foes whenever you apply those protections to yourself.
items.description: You ward your allies from the attacks of your foes whenever you apply those protections to yourself. When you gain a status bonus to AC and saves from Esoteric Warden, you can choose to grant the same benefit to all allies within 30 feet.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Shared Warding

items.name: Thaumaturge's Demesne
items.summary: You have claimed an area or location as your demesne, granting you the ability to ward and protect it.
items.description:
You have claimed an area or location as your demesne, granting you the ability to ward and protect it. When you select this feat, choose a demesne, an area of no more than 2,000 square feet. You must legitimately own the area or, if its a public area, you must lay claim to the area without anyone contesting it.

Once you've chosen your demesne, it's automatically protected by an arcane Peaceful Bubble spell with an unlimited duration, heightened to half your level rounded up and using your thaumaturge class DC in place of a spell DC, if necessary. Additionally, the demesne is attended by three unseen custodians, as a successful Unseen Custodians ritual, and one object in the area gains an elemental sentinel, as a successful Elemental Sentinel ritual.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Thaumaturge's Demesne

items.name: Esoteric Reflexes
items.prerequisites: an implement that grants a reaction
items.summary: Reacting with an implement becomes instinct.
items.description: Reacting with an implement becomes instinct. At the start of your turn, you gain an additional reaction, which you can use for only reactions granted by your implements.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Esoteric Reflexes

items.name: Grand Talisman Esoterica
items.summary: You've gained the ability to place multiple talismans on an item.
items.description: You've gained the ability to place multiple talismans on an item. Normally, affixing more than one talisman to an item causes the talismans to be suppressed, but when you Affix a Talisman, you can specially treat one item you're working on, allowing it to have two active talismans at once. This special treatment ends if you use Affix a Talisman to treat a new item with this ability.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Grand Talisman Esoterica

items.name: Trespass Teleportation
items.summary: You can hunt your foe to the ends of creation.
items.description:
**Requirements** You are benefiting from Exploit Vulnerability.

**Trigger** The target of your Exploit Vulnerability is within 120 feet and uses a teleportation effect.

You can hunt your foe to the ends of creation. You teleport along with the enemy, appearing the same direction and distance from it as you were before it teleported (or the nearest unoccupied space if your destination is occupied). Any allies affected by Share Weakness or Ubiquitous Weakness, if you have those abilities, can spend their reaction to teleport along with the enemy if they're within 120 of the enemy and choose to do so.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Trespass Teleportation

items.name: Implement's Flight
items.summary: By weakening your relation to the ground and strengthening your relation to the sky, you've learned to soar through the air, your implement carrying you as surely as any broomstick or pestle.
items.description: By weakening your relation to the ground and strengthening your relation to the sky, you've learned to soar through the air, your implement carrying you as surely as any broomstick or pestle. As long as you're holding a thaumaturge implement, you gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Implement's Flight

items.name: Seven-Part Link
items.summary: Many traditions hold the number seven as significant.
items.description: Many traditions hold the number seven as significant. By exchanging pieces of a seven-part set of esoterica, you create a magical web by which your allies can affect each other at a distance. When you use Paired Link during your daily preparations, you can exchange linking esoterica with up to six willing allies, keeping one piece for yourself. In addition to the normal effects of Paired Link, if a linked ally casts a spell with a range of touch, they can target linked allies within 30 feet with that spell.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Seven-Part Link

items.name: Sever Magic
items.summary: You apply a frayed thread, a pinch of fulu ash, or a similar undone charm to your weapon, and swing to break a spell.
items.description:
**Requirements** You're holding an implement.

You apply a frayed thread, a pinch of fulu ash, or a similar undone charm to your weapon, and swing to break a spell. Make a Strike against an enemy. If you hit and deal damage, you attempt to counteract a single spell active on the target (your choice). Your counteract rank is equal to half your level (rounded up), and your counteract check modifier is equal to your class DC - 10.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Sever Magic

items.name: Grand Scroll Esoterica
items.summary: You've completed the third and final step in your assimilation of scroll esoterica, granting you daily scrolls of incredible power.
items.description: You've completed the third and final step in your assimilation of scroll esoterica, granting you daily scrolls of incredible power. In addition to your daily scrolls from Scroll Esoterica and Elaborate Scroll Esoterica, add a single scroll with a 6th-rank spell. At 20th level, add a scroll with a 7th-rank spell.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Grand Scroll Esoterica

items.name: Implement's Assault
items.summary: Your implement supercharges your weapon to shoot an impossible volley or carve through your foes.
items.description:
**Requirements** You're holding an implement.

Your implement supercharges your weapon to shoot an impossible volley or carve through your foes. Make a Strike with your weapon against each enemy within 30 feet of you. You don't increase your multiple attack penalty until after making all the attacks. If your weapon is a melee weapon and any of the attacks are outside your reach, you Release the weapon before the Strikes, and it returns to your grasp after all of them. If your hands are full when the weapon returns, it falls to the ground in your space.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Implement's Assault

items.name: Intense Implement
items.summary: You have an exceptional link to your third implement.
items.description: You have an exceptional link to your third implement. You gain the adept benefit for your third implement.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Intense Implement

items.name: Ubiquitous Weakness
items.summary: You've nurtured your bonds with your comrades, allowing you to share the benefits of your esoterica.
items.description: You've nurtured your bonds with your comrades, allowing you to share the benefits of your esoterica. When you use Exploit Vulnerability and choose mortal weakness, select any number of allies within 30 feet of you. Their Strikes apply the weakness from mortal weakness the same way your Strikes do. This benefit ends when you stop benefiting from Exploit Vulnerability. Since this effect depends on magically strengthening your bond to your allies, only allies with whom you've developed a rapport over the course of one or more days gain the benefit.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Ubiquitous Weakness

items.name: Unlimited Demesne
items.summary: You can move your demesne here and there, bringing it wherever your journey takes you.
items.description: You can move your demesne here and there, bringing it wherever your journey takes you. Your demesne expands to a maximum of 10,000 square feet. Once per day, you can call your demesne forth, which takes 1 minute. This has the effects of Resplendent Mansion, except that it conjures your demesne from its previous location, with all the benefits of Thaumaturge's Demesne in addition to the those of the spell. You must be able to claim the new area, with the same restrictions as Thaumaturge's Demesne.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Unlimited Demesne

items.name: Wonder Worker
items.prerequisites: legendary in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion
items.summary: The thaumaturge's path culminates with the working of wonders.
items.description: The thaumaturge's path culminates with the working of wonders. Once per day, you can align your esoterica to cast a spell of 8th rank or lower that takes 1, 2, or 3 actions to cast. The spell must be common or one to which you have access. You can choose a spell of any tradition for which you're legendary in the associated skill (Arcana for arcane, Nature for primal, Occultism for occult, or Religion for divine). Use your thaumaturge class DC in place of any necessary spell DC and your thaumaturge class DC - 10 in place of any necessary counteract modifier or spell attack modifier.
items.cite: Dark Archive (Remastered) — Feats: Wonder Worker

items.name: Arms That Cut the Waves
items.summary: River, lake, sea, or ocean, the water calls to you, and you don't fear its depths.
items.description: River, lake, sea, or ocean, the water calls to you, and you don't fear its depths. When you attempt an Athletics check to Swim, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. When you would run out of air and begin suffocating, you can instead spend a Mythic Point to hold your breath for 10 more rounds.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Arms That Cut the Waves

items.name: Binds That Tie
items.summary: You excel at assisting in capturing your foes.
items.description: You excel at assisting in capturing your foes. When you attempt a check to Grapple an opponent who's already grabbed by an ally, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. On a success, you deal additional bludgeoning damage to the target equal to twice your Strength modifier.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Binds That Tie

items.name: Ears That Hear the Truth
items.summary: You have an acute understanding of the rhythms of living things, and you never miss the quaver that betrays a spoken lie.
items.description: You have an acute understanding of the rhythms of living things, and you never miss the quaver that betrays a spoken lie. When you attempt to Sense Motive, or when you roll Perception for initiative, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check or roll at mythic proficiency.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Ears That Hear the Truth

items.name: Feet That Stride the Sky
items.summary: You feel the call of the sky, or perhaps a desperate urge to test the limits of the earth's hold on you.
items.description: You feel the call of the sky, or perhaps a desperate urge to test the limits of the earth's hold on you. When you or a creature you're mounted on attempts a High Jump or Long Jump, you can spend a Mythic Point to allow you or the mount to attempt the check at mythic proficiency; determine the DC using the Long Jump DCs, and increase your maximum distance to double your Speed.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Feet That Stride the Sky

items.name: Hands That Unweave Disaster
items.summary: Your hands move with uncanny sureness, dismantling danger.
items.description: Your hands move with uncanny sureness, dismantling danger. When you attempt an Acrobatics check to Grab an Edge, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. You can expend a Mythic Point when attempting to Disable a Device to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. As normal when attempting a check with mythic proficiency, this allows you to attempt to Disable a Device even if the check normally requires expert or greater proficiency.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Hands That Unweave Disaster

items.name: Storied Companion
items.prerequisites: Handler's Calling; you have an animal companion or pet
items.summary: Your companion is an integral part of your story, and you can expend your mythic power to protect it, defying events that would prevent it from being so.
items.description:
**Trigger** Your animal companion or pet would fail a saving throw.

Your companion is an integral part of your story, and you can expend your mythic power to protect it, defying events that would prevent it from being so. Spend a Mythic Point; your companion rerolls the triggering save at mythic proficiency and gains temporary Hit Points equal to twice your level that last for 1 minute.

Effect: Storied Companion
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Storied Companion

items.name: We've Met Before
items.summary: Your ability to discern information about those you interact with is without peer.
items.description:
**Requirements** You've spent at least 1 minute in mutual conversation with a creature.

Your ability to discern information about those you interact with is without peer. Spend a Mythic Point to gain a Lore skill specific to the required creature for the next 24 hours; you have mythic proficiency with that skill and can use it to Recall Knowledge about the creature, Decipher Writings created by the creature, Earn Income or Subsist in areas ruled by the creature, or perform other appropriate tasks as determined by the GM.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: We've Met Before

items.name: Become Shadow
items.summary: You unleash your mythic power to shroud yourself in darkness and silence to stalk your prey.
items.description: You unleash your mythic power to shroud yourself in darkness and silence to stalk your prey. When you attempt a check to Hide or Sneak, or when you roll Stealth for initiative, you can spend a Mythic Point to become concealed and to attempt the check or roll using mythic proficiency.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Become Shadow

items.name: Cutting Rebuke
items.summary: If words could kill, the poet might rule the world.
items.description: If words could kill, the poet might rule the world. Your words can. You gain the Bon Mot skill feat. You can spend a Mythic Point when rolling the Diplomacy check for Bon Mot to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. If the check succeeds, you can also deal mental damage equal to your level to the target (double on a critical success).
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Cutting Rebuke

items.name: Godspeed
items.summary: Mythic power grants you speed to rival beasts and demigods.
items.description: Mythic power grants you speed to rival beasts and demigods. Spend a Mythic Point; for the next minute, you gain a +10-foot status bonus to all your Speeds and are quickened. You can use the extra action each round to Stride, Step, or Leap.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Godspeed

items.name: Prescience
items.summary: Mythic power floods through your mind, filling you with visions of possible futures, events that might or might not happen, and warnings of things that might be.
items.description:
**Trigger** You're about to roll initiative.

Mythic power floods through your mind, filling you with visions of possible futures, events that might or might not happen, and warnings of things that might be. Spend a Mythic Point and roll your initiative check using mythic proficiency. Until the end of your first turn, you have a +1 status bonus to AC and all saves.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Prescience

items.name: Read the Wind
items.summary: You can derive meaning from the tiniest details when tracking an enemy.
items.description: You can derive meaning from the tiniest details when tracking an enemy. Whenever you succeed at a check to Track at mythic proficiency, you can immediately attempt a check to Recall Knowledge about the creature you're tracking, also at mythic proficiency and with a suitable skill determined by the GM.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Read the Wind

items.name: Unbelievably Believable
items.summary: Your words echo with soothing and convincing power.
items.description: Your words echo with soothing and convincing power. When you attempt a check to Gather Information, Make an Impression, make a Request, or Lie, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Unbelievably Believable

items.name: Unending Subsistence
items.summary: Your mythic power allows you to take a small amount of food and replicate it near endlessly.
items.description:
Your mythic power allows you to take a small amount of food and replicate it near endlessly. When you attempt a Society or Survival check to Subsist, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the check at mythic proficiency. Succeeding at the check always provides enough food and shelter for you and up to a dozen other creatures. On a critical success, all creatures you obtain food and shelter for gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Fortitude saving throws for the next 24 hours.

Effect: Unending Subsistence
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Unending Subsistence

items.name: Correct the Story
items.summary: You know the story of your journey well and can correct it when your enemy tells it incorrectly.
items.description:
**Trigger** An enemy critically succeeds at an attack roll or saving throw.

You know the story of your journey well and can correct it when your enemy tells it incorrectly. Spend a Mythic Point. The enemy must reroll the triggering attack roll or save and take the new result.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Correct the Story

items.name: Divert Destiny
items.summary: You defy the fate before you, calling on wells of mythic vitality to sustain your life and allow you to persevere.
items.description:
**Trigger** An attack or effect would reduce you to 0 Hit Points or kill you outright.

You defy the fate before you, calling on wells of mythic vitality to sustain your life and allow you to persevere. You expend 1 Mythic Point and survive the triggering attack or effect, lose the wounded or dying conditions entirely, don't increase your doomed condition, and are conscious and standing with a number of Hit Points equal to 10 + your level, regardless of how many Hit Points you had before.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Divert Destiny

items.name: Fling Into Action
items.summary: You release mythic power to turn disaster into opportunity and hurl yourself into an advantageous position.
items.description: You release mythic power to turn disaster into opportunity and hurl yourself into an advantageous position. When you attempt a Reflex save, you can spend a Mythic Point to attempt the save at mythic proficiency. If the check is successful, you immediately fling yourself up to 30 feet in a direction of your choice, or up to 60 feet on a critical success. When flinging yourself in this manner, you can move the entire distance in a straight horizontal or vertical line, or you can move 5 feet horizontally for every 10 feet you move vertically. For example, if you got a critical success using Fling Into Action while Grabbing an Edge as you fall from the middle of a cliff, you could hurl yourself 40 feet up the cliffside and 20 feet forward onto a plateau at the top of the cliff.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Fling Into Action

items.name: Mythic Counterspell
items.prerequisites: Quick Recognition; ability to cast spells from spell slots; Sage's Calling
items.summary: You quench and counter your enemy's magic with potent spellcraft amplified and enhanced by carefully deployed mythic power.
items.description:
**Trigger** A creature Casts a Spell, you've successfully Recognized the Spell, and you have either a prepared spell or an unexpended spell slot of equal or greater rank.

You quench and counter your enemy's magic with potent spellcraft amplified and enhanced by carefully deployed mythic power. Spend a Mythic Point, and expend a prepared spell or unexpended spell slot of the same rank as the triggering spell or higher. You lose your spell slot as if you'd cast the triggering spell. You then attempt to counteract the triggering spell using mythic proficiency to determine your spellcasting proficiency bonus for the counteract check.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Mythic Counterspell

items.name: Repel Assault
items.summary: Your Calling demands that you defy danger and injury to yourself or those who rely on you while allowing you to respond to the originators of such aggression with ferocious and unrivaled fury.
items.description:
**Trigger** An enemy's attack would deal damage equal to or greater than your level to you or an adjacent ally.

Your Calling demands that you defy danger and injury to yourself or those who rely on you while allowing you to respond to the originators of such aggression with ferocious and unrivaled fury. Spend a Mythic Point; you gain resistance to the triggering attack equal to your level. If you Strike the enemy that made the attack before the end of your next turn, you can make that Strike at mythic proficiency. This benefit applies only to the first Strike you make against that enemy.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Repel Assault

items.name: Unrivaled Retort
items.summary: You defy the death and destruction around you while using it to fuel your mythic power, spurring you on to acts of incredible speed and empowering a mighty ranged counterattack.
items.description:
**Trigger** You are about to attempt a Fortitude or Reflex save against an area effect and are wielding a ranged weapon.

You defy the death and destruction around you while using it to fuel your mythic power, spurring you on to acts of incredible speed and empowering a mighty ranged counterattack. Spend a Mythic Point and attempt the triggering save at mythic proficiency. If the save is successful, you can immediately reload and make a ranged Strike targeting the originator of the triggering effect.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Unrivaled Retort

items.name: Arc of Destruction
items.summary: You redirect an incoming weapon or projectile and send your enemy's own attack roaring back at them, increasing its accuracy with a surge of mythic power.
items.description:
**Trigger** An enemy you're observing targets you with a ranged weapon Strike.

You redirect an incoming weapon or projectile and send your enemy's own attack roaring back at them, increasing its accuracy with a surge of mythic power. Spend a Mythic Point; you gain a +4 status bonus to AC against the triggering Strike. If the Strike fails, you immediately snatch the weapon or ammunition used for the attack out of the air and launch it back at the enemy, using mythic proficiency for your Strike. If the attack was made with a thrown weapon, add the weapon's runes and other effects to the attack as normal. If the triggering attack was made with a piece of ammunition that you're wielding an appropriate weapon for, you can apply your weapon's runes and other effects to the attack.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Arc of Destruction

items.name: Mythic Allies
items.prerequisites: ability to cast spells from slots; at least one summon spell in your spellbook or repertoire
items.summary: You channel mythic power through your body and into a summoned ally, temporarily reinforcing them with a shared fraction of your mythic potential.
items.description:
You channel mythic power through your body and into a summoned ally, temporarily reinforcing them with a shared fraction of your mythic potential. Spend a Mythic Point; the summoned creature gains a +2 status bonus to its attack rolls, a +2 status bonus to all of its defenses, and a number of additional Hit Points equal to your level that last for the duration of its summoning. The next Strike made by the summoned creature after you use this ability gains a +4 circumstance bonus to the attack roll.

Effect: Mythic Allies
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Mythic Allies

items.name: Mythic Magic
items.summary: You convert your mythic power into a magical effect.
items.description:
You convert your mythic power into a magical effect. When you gain this feat, choose up to three spells of 1st or 2nd rank that take no more than 3 actions to cast and that are either instantaneous or have a duration of 10 minutes or less. You can spend a Mythic Point to cast any of those spells for their normal action cost and use mythic proficiency to determine your spell attack rolls and spell DCs, and the spells are automatically heightened to a rank equal to half your level (rounded up). If you don't normally have the ability to cast spells, you use Charisma as your spellcasting attribute modifier; otherwise, you use the spellcasting ability associated with your spellcasting class. You gain the Cast a Spell activity only for spells cast with this feat; you don't otherwise gain the typical benefits of being a spellcaster.

**Special** At 14th level, add one spell of 3rd rank for you to cast using this ability. At 20th level, add one 4th-rank spell.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Mythic Magic

items.name: Mythic Refocus
items.summary: As your ability to control your mythic power grows, you learn to channel it to restore and reinforce other forms of power at your command.
items.description: As your ability to control your mythic power grows, you learn to channel it to restore and reinforce other forms of power at your command. Spend a Mythic Point; you immediately recover all your Focus Points, filling your focus pool to its current maximum.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Mythic Refocus

items.name: Steal Magic
items.summary: You don't just counter your enemy's magic, you instantly master it and make it your own.
items.description: You don't just counter your enemy's magic, you instantly master it and make it your own. When you successfully counterspell an enemy's spell using Mythic Counterspell, you can learn that spell as long as it's on the spell list for your tradition. If you have a spellbook, the spell is instantly scribed into the book, creating new blank pages if needed. If you have a spell repertoire, you can instantly retrain any spell currently in your repertoire to the countered spell, though if the spell you replace is one granted to you by a class feature (such as an animist's apparition spells or a sorcerer's bloodline spells), the spell reverts to the one normally granted by that class feature during your next daily preparations.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Steal Magic

items.name: Summon Mythic Power
items.summary: You call upon fate, divinity, or whatever other power has carried you this far, demanding that it carry you just a little bit farther.
items.description:
**Frequency** once per day

You call upon fate, divinity, or whatever other power has carried you this far, demanding that it carry you just a little bit farther. You regain 1 Mythic Point.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Summon Mythic Power

items.name: Unbelievable Interception
items.summary: You move with unbelievable alacrity to intercept an enemy's attack.
items.description:
**Trigger** An enemy you're observing attempts to Strike an ally you can also observe.

You move with unbelievable alacrity to intercept an enemy's attack. Spend a Mythic Point; stride twice directly toward the triggering enemy. If you end within the attack's range or reach, you become the target of the triggering Strike, using the original attack roll and comparing the result to your AC. If the enemy's attack fails and the enemy is within your reach, you can immediately attempt a melee Strike against the enemy at mythic proficiency.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Unbelievable Interception

items.name: Become Destiny
items.summary: You defy any external force blocking your mythic purpose.
items.description: You defy any external force blocking your mythic purpose. Spend a Mythic Point, and remove any one condition you're afflicted with, end the ongoing effects of any one spell you're currently affected by, or free yourself from the effects of any one trap or hazard (such as a snare or bottomless pit). When freeing yourself from a hazard in this way, you immediately move to the nearest safe location adjacent to the hazard.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Become Destiny

items.name: Call From Death's Door
items.summary: Even death halts in the face of your power.
items.description:
**Trigger** The dying condition of an ally you're observing would increase.

Even death halts in the face of your power. Spend a Mythic Point; the triggering ally loses the dying condition, their wounded condition doesn't increase, and they heal a number of Hit Points equal to twice your level.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Call From Death's Door

items.name: Eyes That See Eternity
items.summary: Mythic power opens your eyes to the secrets of reality and eternity.
items.description: Mythic power opens your eyes to the secrets of reality and eternity. Spend a Mythic Point; for the next minute, you gain the effects of Truesight and roll all Perception checks with mythic proficiency.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Eyes That See Eternity

items.name: Mythic Casting
items.summary: You can infuse mythic power directly into your spells to make them exceptionally potent.
items.description: You can infuse mythic power directly into your spells to make them exceptionally potent. Spend a Mythic Point; if the next action you use is to Cast a Spell, use mythic proficiency to determine your spell attack rolls and save DC for that spell.
items.cite: War of Immortals — Feats: Mythic Casting

items.name: Mythic Containment
items.summary: You infuse a receptacle, such as a normal bag, sack, or box, with mythic power, transforming it into a prison into which you can command a creature.
items.description: You infuse a receptacle, such as a normal bag, sack, or box, with mythic power, transforming it into a prison into which you can command a creature.
